fields.label: Task title
fields.description: Private actionable task title bound to the prepared review and withheld from workspace inspection.

fields.label: Project reference
fields.description: Exact authoritative project record identity required by the selected task policy.

fields.label: Assignee
fields.description: Optional current-user assignment resolved through the authenticated workspace instead of accepting an unverified person identifier.

fields.label: Next action date
fields.description: Optional private calendar date pinned exactly as YYYY-MM-DD rather than a relative phrase.

fields.label: Task context
fields.description: Optional portable context classification; a resolved project requires the Project classification.
